_comment: box_decades4.json with voids: the same 30x30 over 3x3, the same four decades groups and 5x dense block, plus a void channel (materials/decades4_void.json's material 2, void in every group) running in from the left face over y in [2.1, 2.4] to x = 1.5, and a block over [2.1, 2.7] x [0.3, 0.9] of material 3, transparent in the top group only. Pins -precon_ref_shift on voids of both kinds: groups 1-3 share one support (all but the channel) and one reference, while group 0 is also void in the block, so it gets a class, a reference and a bin of its own (the 'void patterns' line on stderr). With every group in its own bin the pmats are the full ones. Painted on cell boundaries.
